title: BLACKPINK's JISOO gifted employees luxury bags worth approximately 400,000 yen... ”Amazing CEO” receives positive feedback | wowKorea
snippet: BLACKPINK's Jisoo is making headlines for giving lavish gifts to the employeesof her one-person entertainment company.
extractedText: Home Entertainment K-POP BLACKPINK's JISOO gifted employees luxury bags worth approximately 400,000 yen... ”Amazing CEO” receives positive feedback Comment BLACKPINK's JISOO gifted employees luxury bags worth approximately 400,000 yen... ”Amazing CEO” receives positive feedback BLACKPINK's Jisoo is making headlines for giving lavish gifts to the employees of her one-person entertainment company. Employees of BLISSOO, a one-person planning company led by JISOO, recently shared stories about JISOO through social media. Along with a photo of a luxury brand bag that O models, she posted comments such as "I love you CEO," "JISOO is the best," and "Thank you CEO," and received the gift. The bag was unveiled. This bag is currently priced at over 400,000 yen. JISOO will be released in 2024 by YG After leaving ENTERTAINMENT, he established "BLISSOO" and continues his independent activities. Also, BLACKPINK, the group to which JISOO belongs, released their mini-album "DEADLINE" on the 27th of last month, their first in 3 years and 5 months. She made a spectacular comeback. Furthermore, JISOO has also been active as an actress, appearing in the Netflix series "Monthly Boyfriend" since March. In addition, at the Cannes International Series Festival to be held in Cannes, France on the 23rd, she will receive the "Madame Figaro Rising Star Award".
